data.name: Whispers of Mexico: La noche de la casada
data.detailed_description:
DIVE INTO THIS ENDLESS NIGHTMARE

Manuel wakes up with amnesia in a forgotten town in Michoacán (1930). What begins as a search for answers turns into a nightmare involving his family, an ancient legend, and a town doomed by sin. What secrets do these fields hide? And why do the whispers of the night mention her daughter?

MAIN FEATURES

Narrative psychological horror: Plot based on little-narrated Mexican legends.

Atmospheric puzzles: Puzzles linked to folklore, riddles and environment.

Immersive world: Rural colonial settings that transport you to Mexico 1930.

Moral dilemmas: Decisions that affect the final outcome with a karma system.

Original soundtrack: Soundtrack created especially to fit the story.

THE CULTURAL PROJECT

"Whispers of Mexico" rescues Mexican oral stories in danger of being forgotten.

The idea was born from my maternal grandmother telling me stories from when she was a child. I explored those stories and decided to "venture" to make a series of games on my own. This is the first story, and I hope you can enjoy it as much as I enjoyed making it.

REVOLCAT

Revolcat Studios presents its first game, and we hope it won't be the only one. We are very excited to write this description because it has been a long road with ups and downs. If you read all this... Thank you very much, you are helping a single Mexican developer to fulfill his dream of developing video games!

data.short_description: Whispers of Mexico is a psychological narrative horror game with puzzle elements set in post-revolutionary Mexico in 1930. Follow Manuel as he navigates his mind, where he must recover his memory, unravel the mystery surrounding the town, and redeem his sins.

content_descriptors.notes: The story that develops within the game touches on issues that, unfortunately, are historical facts of Mexico's past and that were part of a very complicated time in the country. We at Revolcat Studios touch the issues with respect and without a vision of morbidity.
